prose: NAND maker Kioxia reported fiscal Q2 operating profit up 22x year over year to about $12.7B, in line with estimates, on the back of ballooning AI data-storage demand - but forecast Q3 operating profit of roughly the same ~$12.7B, below the ~$14.9B analysts expected, warning that the AI-fueled surge in flash prices is not a straight line, per Bloomberg via Techmeme. The Bloomberg article is paywalled to the fetcher (HTTP 403), so figures come from the feed's report.
highlights: Kioxia FY Q2 operating profit up 22x YoY to ~$12.7B, in line with estimates
AI data-storage demand is driving flash memory prices, but the outlook trails hopes
basis: Techmeme summary of the Bloomberg report; Bloomberg returns HTTP 403 to the fetcher
